notes.title: New Punch, New Looks, New Me!!!
notes.content:
[b]-Additions and Changes[/b]

I've added so much since the last update. I updated the multiplayer to work as intended. it's still a little bit janky but it won't release till it's annoying aspects are unnoticeable. I've added a map and waypoint system. A Npc faction and role system that will change their stats depending on who they are. Npc optimization has also been added to account for if there are a lot of enemies on screen or in the world. I also revamped the character creation system to account for a lot of different styles and faster way to see and pick through those styles. I also added an equipment hot bar for all your items that you need to scroll through quickly. And a lot various other changes have been made to make the game feel as good as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710433/e5e4545aaa2bf61fe947b8f847b3be533ac77ed6.png[/img]

[b]-Hopes for the future[/b]

Finally, I hope that I can get close to a stable Alpha release soon so everyone can play for a bit and have some fun. But I think I need a bit more time to get everything right. I feel like once I'm able to get all the core gameplay systems feeling good and stable then everything else should be fine. 

Hopefully in the future everything I've done here will have its purpose. I've put so much of my life into building the systems that have contributed to creating this game. 

One day in the future a kid will hear about a game called Wonder Wonder Punch. That kid's gonna experience a new world that feels alive and beautiful. They are gonna feel the same way I did when I got out of the sewers from oblivion and explored and told my friends about the adventures I had. 
Soon kid, just give me a bit more time!!!

notes.title: Stealth Fucking Sucks! Wonder Wonder Punch Now Has Stealth!
notes.content:
[b]Wonder Wonder Punch Now has Stealth![/b] Combat is fun in games, but I do also like to just take out a whole camp of enemies just by planning stealth fights then the last guy gets to fight me one on one! Whichever way you want to go about a fight is up to you in the end. But I grew up playing stealth games so adding it to WWP felt like it was purposeful. also, I do feel like stealth does get boring if it's just you getting through an entire game just by stealth killing so I made it so anyone higher level than you can't be killed just by stealth. so you can grind before hitting a camp or something then go in there and blow their backs out. Hopefully as I test it, it proves to be the right choice without being a hassle. but if not ill just revert it. 

[b]anyways the goal is to have an open alpha sometime at the end of the year hopefully! [/b]
